about: Click Holdings Limited provides human resources solutions in Hong Kong. It operates through three segments: Professional Solution Services, Nursing Solution Services, and Logistics and Other Solution Services. The Professional Solution Services segment offers outsourcing and consulting services, including the secondment of senior executives, such as chief financial officers and company secretaries to perform compliance, financial reporting, and financial management functions for customers; accounting and audit professionals to perform audit work; and corporate finance experts to assist in drafting of documents, including circulars, announcements, and others, as well as listing documents. Its Nursing Solution Services segment provides talent sourcing services tailored to nursing home clients, as well as human resources solutions to social service organizations, nursing homes, and individual clients. The Logistics and Other Solution Services segment offers human resources solutions by matching workers, such as packaging staff and movers with both temporary and permanent vacancies, as well as short-term workers, promoters and/or cashiers for job positions relevant to temporary or short-term events and/or pop-up stores. The company was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Kowloon, Hong Kong. Click Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Tk Operations Ltd.
